newsitem.title: CUBA: China to grant $6 million credit to Cuba.
newsitem.headline: China to grant $6 million credit to Cuba.

text.p: China is to grant a $6 million credit facility to Cuba, as well as donating some 50 diesel engines for use in the island's sugar sector, official Cuban media said on Monday.
The national news agency AIN said the deals would be finalised during a current visit by a Chinese trade mission headed by China's deputy prime minister Li Lanqing.
The Chinese delegation, in Havana until Tuesday, held talks on Monday with economy Minister Jose Luis Rodrgiuez.

AIN said the two sides were also due to sign an agreement for cooperation on a rice farm in the eastern province of Granma, and a letter of intent for a joint venture to build a hotel at the beach resort of Varadero.
The agency did not give details of the credit facility, other than saying it was aimed at investment.
Annual bilateral trade between the two communist nations is about $300 million.
